title: QUIZ - 56
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate whether a specific value satisfies a program's inequality condition
questions.question: A program's condition is \( y \geq 68 \). If y = 70, does the condition evaluate to true?
questions.explanation: Substituting y = 70: \(70 \geq 68\) is true.
questions.hint: Substitute the given value into the condition and evaluate whether the inequality holds.

questions.learningObjective: Translate a two-sided range condition into a compound inequality
questions.question: A program requires the input t to be at least 9 and at most 27. Write this as a compound inequality.
questions.explanation: "At least 9" means \(t \geq 9\), and "at most 27" means \(t \leq 27\). Combined: \( 9 \leq t \leq 27 \).
questions.hint: Combine both boundary conditions into a single compound inequality using the correct inclusive symbols.

questions.learningObjective: Translate a described program condition into inequality notation
questions.question: A program only proceeds if the variable y is at least 6. Write this condition as an inequality.
questions.explanation: The phrase in the condition directly corresponds to the symbol \( \geq \), giving \( y \geq 6 \).
questions.hint: Match the condition's wording (at least, at most, less than, greater than) to the correct inequality symbol.
